items.notes: The desktop showed a readiness-stage failure. OMP exited 1 and reported that the approved model was not found.
No prompt was submitted after the launch failure.
Not reached after the launch failure.
The scratch workspace was verified before start; target retention across navigation was not reached.
No stream or active turn to interrupt.

No live callback was reached.
The failed start created no saved conversation.
The approved native journal directory remained empty.
No child was started.
Startup cleanup is not close with active work.
The desktop and host exited normally during cleanup, without a live or saved OMP conversation.
Both scratch panes reached Idle before their first prompt and displayed omp-rpc 19.2.1.
The first user event appeared once and the turn reported completed before returning to Idle.
The reply grew across Running snapshots. After Idle the beginning was still accessible by scrolling; the final journal contained one answer with entries 1 through 24, each once.
With B selected, the original A pane wrote only in A and the callback returned the same session and A target as the host record.
Stop was clicked while the reply was growing. The UI reported Stopped and the turn ended cancelled; the original runtime handle remained live and accepted the next prompt.
The native card offered only Approve and Deny. Approve authorized the one verified write and the expected bytes appeared in A.
Deny produced a visible native denial and the file stayed absent from both scratch workspaces.
The write cards showed in-progress and terminal results, including the native denial and the authorized write completion verified on disk.
The UI changed from not yet used to connected after a completed session-info call; the structured result matched the host session, role, adapter and A target.
The attempt stopped after unexpected exit during the quit step; no reopen or explicit Continue occurred.
The original root journal remained on disk, but the desktop was not reopened and root history replay was not observed.

One child completed on the approved model per its journal. Its pane showed the attributed earlier transcript and live section without composer or actions on the conversation; controls remained on the parent.
Cancelling Close left B's permission pending. Confirming removed B, both retained B handles signaled exit 0, the held write stayed absent and A remained live.
Invoking the Windows title-bar Close exited without an observed warning or a Cancel decision while A's permission was pending. The runtime exited 1; the host did not record a coordinated quit.
